name: safetyx2_prefx1_sky_x1_small
description: A small subset of a multilingual reward-benchmark focused on safety-related preference data. It provides paired comparisons of model outputs to measure which responses humans prefer with respect to safety and alignment criteria across languages. Intended for training and evaluating reward models and preference predictors in safety-sensitive scenarios.
reputation: Moderately used within research on multilingual reward modeling and safety alignment; not a widely adopted community-wide standard.
